2607.08182.title: LEEVLA: Seeing What Matters in Latent Environment Evolution for Vision-Language-Action
2607.08182.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to map multimodal inputs to robot actions. However, most existing approaches struggle to cover complex dynamic scenarios due to treating all visual tokens uniformly and reasoning with human-selected factors, which lack mechanisms to emphasize task-critical evidence and ignore underlying factors. To address this issue, we propose LEEVLA, a VLA architecture for seeing what matters in Latent Environment Evolution that explicitly guides the model toward informative regions while preserving the structured evolution of latent world representations. To identify salient and instruction-relevant regions, we introduce drift-guided dynamic prioritization (DGDP), which combines dynamic position prioritization (DPP) with semantic drift guidance (SDG) to guide the VLA agent where to attend during training. On top of this, we introduce structured feature flow generation (SFFG), which models how these prioritized features should evolve in latent space via prototype-to-periphery (P2P) prediction, and a mutual-neighborhood contrastive (MC) loss to maintain topological consistency among neighborhoods. Together, DGDP and SFFG form a task-aware "where-how" training framework. Extensive experiments on VLA benchmarks show that LEEVLA consistently outperforms prior methods, confirming that explicit task-evidence guidance and structured latent reasoning are both crucial for scalable VLA. Our code is available at https://github.com/LyuQi127/LEEVLA.
2607.08182.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型旨在將多模態輸入映射到機器人行動上。<lb/>然而，大多數現有方法在處理複雜的動態場景時面臨困難，因為它們將所有視覺標記統一對待，並依賴人類選擇的因素進行推理，這缺乏強調任務關鍵證據的機制並忽略了潛在因素。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了LEEVLA，一種VLA架構，用於在潛在環境演變中看到重要的事物，明確指導模型朝向信息豐富的區域，同時保持潛在世界表示的結構演變。<lb/>為了識別顯著且與指令相關的區域，我們引入了漂移引導的動態優先級（DGDP），它將動態位置優先級（DPP）與語義漂移引導（SDG）結合起來，以指導VLA代理在訓練期間應該關注的地方。<lb/>在此基礎上，我們引入了結構化特徵流生成（SFFG），它通過原型到邊緣（P2P）預測來建模這些優先特徵在潛在空間中的演變方式，以及一種互鄰對比（MC）損失，以保持鄰域之間的拓撲一致性。<lb/>DGDP和SFFG共同形成了一個任務感知的「何處-如何」訓練框架。<lb/>在VLA基準上的廣泛實驗顯示，LEEVLA始終優於先前的方法，確認明確的任務證據引導和結構化的潛在推理對於可擴展的VLA都是至關重要的。<lb/>我們的代碼可在https://github.com/LyuQi127/LEEVLA獲得。
